title: Grateful Dead Live at Park West Ski Resort on 1983-09-04
source: 2 Source Matrix by Dusborne; Soundboard (shnid:117185) SBD -> Cassette Master -> Reel (Technics Deck) -> Dat (Panasonic SV3800/48k); Dat -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC and Audience (shnid:104956) MAC  FOB 2 Beyer M160 & 1 Sennheiser 441 > Sony TCD5M >  Sound Blaster PCI> CD Wav

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording captures a decent show with solid sound, though the track listing is misordered.
ai_review.review: The performance is described as decent and the matrix source provides good overall audio quality. Reviewers note that the track list is inaccurate—Man Smart, Woman Smarter appears after Fire and is mislabeled as Drums—but this does not appear to detract significantly from listening enjoyment.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review, but a 4‑star rating and positive language indicate a good show with decent matrix recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall sound is solid; reviewers call it a decent recording. The only issue noted is an incorrect track listing.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Setlist order appears inaccurate (Man Smart, Woman Smarter placed after Fire and mislabeled), but no comments on musical performance quality.
